assets.name: panel
assets.prompt:
Create ONE production-ready raster game UI asset for a refined portrait Three Kingdoms city-building game. Palette is grounded in an imperial Chinese palace: warm pale jade / white stone, restrained aged gold, deep jade enamel, and vermilion lacquer. Fine hand-painted game-art craftsmanship, readable at small UI scale, elegant and restrained. No text, lettering, Chinese characters, numbers, logos, UI mockup, surrounding scene or watermarks. No black brushstroke backgrounds, no thick industrial metal frame, no exaggerated neon. Use genuinely transparent background outside the isolated asset.
Asset: a single wide horizontal blank upgrade-information panel, approximately 1.8:1 aspect ratio. A warm ivory white-jade tablet / subtle fine silk-paper center, very low-contrast material texture and a large totally clean light center for editable dark UI text. Thin aged-gold edging and tiny traditional cloud-scroll engravings confined to the four corners. Gently chamfered corners, tasteful soft relief, almost flat front orthographic view, minimal bevel. Shape should fill 94% of canvas with small transparent outer margins, crisp alpha. Border should be shallow, clean, and suitable for nine-slice scaling; no internal sections, no icons.
